label: copy-phase input c when the next output is c or 2, late in the copy
explanation: Very sparse copy-phase feature. Every activation is at a step where the fed-back input is c. Nearly all of them (about 98% of activation mass) are at steps where the token being output is c (repeated c) or 2 (original c followed by 2). Firing is concentrated late in the copy, at recall_idx 4 to 8 (t >= 13 accounts for most of the mass). Lift is highest at t = 16 and for L = 9. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, never on any input other than c, and almost never when the output is anything other than c or 2. Precision is low (about 12% for the predicate): most late-copy steps with input c and output c/2 do not activate it, and the variables available do not separate those from the active ones (false positives look the same as true hits). The largest activations come from the c->2 and c->c contexts at recall_idx 5 to 6. Activation counts rise with recall_idx/L, but I have not checked whether magnitude does.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=c (+3.45), phase=2 & out_tok=2 (+2.79), in_tok=c (+2.77), out_tok=2 (+2.55), phase=2 & out_tok=c (+2.19), out_tok=c (+2.15).
